answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop cheap fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents to prove live compute in minutes; a miss drops the agent to the nadir of trust and forfeits its deposit. Honest agents answer once and keep earning. An attacker with 1,000 fakes pays 5 POA per fake per day, 5,000 POA a day against a 3,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money. The trust reef holds only while each member keeps its timber standing.
